title: Therapy Course Reversal Amount
content:
## Course reversal — Medicaid Managed Care Membership

**Clause.** The therapy window is the 12 therapy window months counted back from the review date, a date counting when it lies fewer than 12 whole months before the review date. The course batch is every paid outpatient hospital claim whose service date falls in the therapy window and whose billing provider is the servicing provider of the member's rehabilitation therapy authorization approved on a request received in the therapy window, whether it is still approved or has since expired. The course reversal is the copays booked on the course batch less the re-rated copays, rounded half up to the cent, and each course visit is re-rated at the category's outpatient hospital copay.

## The quantities

| Quantity | Definition |
|---|---|
| Review date | The date the course is rated. |
| Therapy window | Every date lying fewer than 12 whole months before the review date. |
| Course authorization | The member's rehabilitation therapy authorization approved on a request received in the therapy window; it qualifies whether it is still approved or has since expired. |
| Course batch | Paid claims in the outpatient hospital copay category, with a service date in the therapy window, billed by that authorization's servicing provider. |
| Copays booked | The total of the member copays booked on the course batch claims. |
| Re-rated copays | The number of course visits multiplied by the category's outpatient hospital copay. |
| Course reversal | The copays booked less the re-rated copays, rounded half up to the cent. |

**Rounding.** Rounding is half up to the cent: before the figure is rounded, a tolerance of 0.0001 cent is added, so an amount sitting on half a cent always rounds up.

## Window boundary (hypothetical dates)

With a hypothetical review date of 15 September 2026, a service date of 16 September 2025 lies 11 whole months and some days before the review date and falls in the therapy window; a service date of 15 September 2025 lies exactly 12 whole months before it and falls outside.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

A member's course authorization, approved on a request received in the therapy window, names a servicing provider that billed five paid outpatient hospital claims in the window. The copays booked on them total 16.50 USD, and the category's outpatient hospital copay is taken, for this illustration only, as 3.00 USD.

1. Re-rated copays: five visits multiplied by 3.00 USD gives 15.00 USD.
2. Course reversal: 16.50 USD less 15.00 USD gives 1.50 USD, which is already a whole cent.

A claim the servicing provider billed under another copay category, a denied claim, or a claim dated outside the therapy window is not part of the course batch and enters neither total.
